goal: Make the live agent-tree monitor accurately communicate active agent hierarchy and runtime metadata in English.
behavior: The interactive monitor refreshes a colorized tree, labels uncertain parentage in English, and shows model and effort for every event-backed subagent; JSON remains structured and uncolored.
facts: The installed monitor writes hook payloads to the shared Git directory and already keeps an additive node object per observed agent.
Interactive mode redraws every two seconds, while --json emits one snapshot.
cause: The renderer hard-codes a Russian parentage label and emits plain text only. Snapshot nodes do not retain model or effort from hook payloads, and process-only sessions are not explicitly distinguished from event-backed agents.
boundaries: Do not alter global user configuration or hook installation behavior beyond recording available runtime metadata.
Do not claim model or effort for a process-only session when no source provides it.
Keep the existing command-line flags and JSON snapshot shape compatible; new fields are additive.
interfaces: Codex and Claude Code hook JSON payloads with optional model and effort fields
dependencies: ANSI-capable terminal for colorized interactive output

criteria.outcome: All tracked product text and rendered labels are English; an unknown parent is labeled 'parent unknown'.
Interactive output conveys live state with ANSI color and refreshes while --json stays valid, uncolored machine-readable data.
Every event-backed subagent includes model and effort in snapshot and render output, using 'unknown' when an event lacks either value; process-only sessions remain visibly source-limited.
The documented monitor behavior matches the shipped output.

escalation: Escalate if either runtime does not expose model or effort in any hook or recoverable transcript payload, because obtaining it would require a new runtime integration.
Escalate if ANSI output must support a terminal capability policy beyond NO_COLOR.

decisions.summary: Use an explicit 'unknown' value when available data has no model or effort rather than infer values from process names.
Use ANSI colors only in interactive rendering: green for running, dim gray for stopped, yellow for unknown, and dim annotation text. Preserve uncolored JSON.

plannerReview.assessment: The diagnosed renderer and snapshot omissions directly explain the reported output. The additive metadata contract, explicit unknown fallback, ANSI-only interactive styling, and independent checks settle the interfaces without asserting unavailable runtime fields.
